creator: Alexander Terp
description:
Every launch repoints `<home>/bin/muster` at its own CLI (`Sources/MusterMac/CommandsLocation.swift`), and the daemon puts that directory first on every pane's PATH. MIP-6 section 5 says a development build and the release may share a home, each with its own daemon and app lock. They cannot share this link: launch a checkout build with the default home and every pane on the release daemon now runs the checkout's `muster` against the release window, until the release app is launched again.

Found 2026-10-14 while setting this laptop up to run Homebrew's Muster day to day and HEAD beside it. `tools/run-checkout` sidesteps it with a home of its own (`~/.muster-dev`), which is also why a checkout run there needs `config.toml` linked across.

Options: only the release install writes `~/.muster/bin/muster` and a development build uses `bin/<install>/muster` or no link; or the link becomes a per-install directory the daemon of that install puts on its own panes' PATH. The daemon-data `bin/muster` shim, which runs `~/.muster/bin/muster`, has to follow whichever is chosen.
title: A checkout build in the release's home takes over every release pane's muster
